name: fix-open-epub-minimized
title: fix: restore window to foreground when opening epub while minimized
description: When the app is already running but minimized, clicking an epub file does not bring the window back to the foreground. Root cause: handle_second_instance in src-tauri/src/open_paths.rs only calls window.set_focus(), but tao's set_focus is a no-op on minimized windows on all three platforms (macOS: if !is_minimized && is_visible; Windows/Linux similar). Fix: unminimize + show + set_focus in handle_second_instance.
creator: Maplume
